metrics.exact_span_precision: maximum matched predicted spans / accepted predicted spans
metrics.exact_span_recall_all_gold_values: matched source spans over all label-side gold values
metrics.exact_span_recall_source_alignable: matched source spans over source-alignable gold values only
metrics.invalid_offset_rate: Phase O outputs rejected by offset/schema validation
metrics.operation_accuracy: predicted INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/UPSERT vs label-side V2 operation
metrics.overlap_rejection_rate: Phase O outputs rejected for duplicate/nested/overlap offsets
metrics.spurious_span_rate: accepted predicted spans not aligned to a label-side gold value

primary_end_to_end_denominator: full train/dev Create denominator; non-alignable samples retained
